The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for Isopropyl caprate in modulating the function of this transporter, potentially through the regulation of DNMT3A2/3L complex activity. The evidence is consistent with a mechanistic link, though further validation would be necessary to confirm the exact nature of the interaction.
